archive.format: deterministic USTAR in gzip, gzip mtime zero, no path prefix; regular files only

diagnostic_meta_import_repair.change: Add a plain meta import alongside the unchanged public runtime import; preserve the #eval body and all 93 stages.

file_order: topological module order, preserving each source ordered explicit import header

license.third_party: Original third-party notices and licenses, if present, are preserved; external toolchain is distributed separately.

source_content_hash_encoding: sorted UTF-8 path + NUL + binary SHA256 + unsigned big-endian uint64 source bytes, concatenated
